styles.name: 3D Toy
styles.description: Smooth rounded stylized toy with simple materials, a clear silhouette and restrained dimensional lighting.

instructions.materials: Use simple smooth toy-like materials with a soft matte or mild satin finish.
instructions.forms: Sculpt rounded compact body masses, clear facial features and sturdy readable limbs.
instructions.linework: Let the clean rendered form boundary define the silhouette without drawn outlines.
instructions.shading: Apply broad soft lighting and restrained contact shading where body parts meet.
instructions.palette: Keep material colors stable with simple local-color surfaces and small predictable highlights.
instructions.texture: Leave surfaces smooth, using only essential seams or markings required by the identity.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated stylized 3D toy with one fixed camera and light direction and no photoreal complexity.

negative_constraints: Avoid photo-studio backdrops, floor shadows, pedestals or reflected scenery.
Do not add tiny molded text, intricate surface scratches or complex metallic coatings.
limitations: Smooth shading still needs strong local-color separation so forms do not merge at compact size.

compatibility.scaling: Render with sufficient source detail, then downsample once with the recommended filter into the existing profile cells; inspect the final silhouette at actual size.
notes: Preserve the original preset’s smooth rounded simple-material direction; the style does not alter atlas geometry.
Keep texture and shading inside the isolated silhouette; preserve the same approved pattern placement across animation states.

instructions.forms: Construct a compact character from broad angular planes with carefully chosen silhouette vertices.
instructions.linework: Let polygon boundaries define internal edges, with no wireframe or ink overlay.
instructions.shading: Shade each facet as a flat value under a single consistent light direction.
instructions.palette: Assign stable approved local colors and a small predictable set of facet-light variants.
instructions.texture: Leave facets untextured; shape and plane lighting supply all surface interest.
instructions.rendering: Render an isolated low-poly mascot with a fixed camera, readable face and consistent apparent polygon scale.

negative_constraints: Avoid random triangulation noise, wireframe grids or photoreal material textures.

notes: Lightly antialias the raster perimeter while preserving flat facet shading; low-poly surfaces do not require a pixel grid.
